links.text:
No fear of heights for these robots! 🪜

Storage tanks need constant coating to prevent corrosion. 

But the work is brutal, workers climb inside or rig up scaffolding at heights, spray paint for hours, breathe fumes. 

It's dangerous and slow.

@QlayersBV replaced it with a semi-automated robot. No worker climbing tanks, and robots handle the coating.

Workers don't operate at dangerous heights anymore. Working hours in hazardous conditions drop dramatically. 

Fewer people exposed to paint fumes and particle exposure.

Robot coating minimizes paint particles released into the air. 200 square meters per hour. Six times faster than manual rolling. 

A tank that takes a crew days now takes hours.

Replacing dangerous, repetitive work that wears people down and kills some of them.

Robots for good. 🦾
